description: This file is a PHP web page used for managing the registration process of cordless handsets via a web interface. It includes HTML, PHP includes, and JavaScript for client-side interactions, specifically handling user actions related to registering or aborting the registration of a cordless handset.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Initializes the page, sets the register mode display based on device settings, and handles button click events for registering or aborting registration.
